name: Chest-supported dumbbell row
definition: Lie chest-down on an inclined bench with dumbbells hanging from straight arms. Pull the dumbbells toward the torso by moving the upper arms back and bending the elbows, then lower.

catalogue_anchor.notes: Original broad muscle labels retained separately; not silently promoted to accepted anatomy.

value.start: Lie chest-down on an inclined bench with dumbbells hanging from straight arms.
value.movement: Pull the dumbbells toward the torso by moving the upper arms back and bending the elbows, then lower.
value.finish: Return to the hanging-arm start with chest contact retained.
value.range_of_motion: Record bench angle, grip and the hand-to-torso endpoint.
